blocks.html: Illuminating appliances designed for post mounting shall be securely and rigidly attached to a post. Posts shall be rigidly mounted in accordance with the requirements of the New York City Building Code. Drain openings shall be provided near the base of posts where there is a possibility of water collecting inside them.
